data.sub: Yuzvendra Chahal T20 cricket mein 400 wicket lene wale pehle Indian bane.

chat.say: Chahal bhai ne toh kamaal kar diya!

data.asar: Record todna koi inhi se seekhe.
data.caption:
Yuzvendra Chahal ne racha itihas!

🏏 T20 cricket mein 400 wicket
🎯 Pehle Indian bowler bane
🌟 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy mein kamaal

Apne dost ko tag karo jo har waqt cricket dekhta hai!
